factors.title: Factors

compute.title: Compute
compute.description: How much compute the run uses, and whether its results may depend on it.

sensor_pixel_um.title: Sensor pixel size
sensor_pixel_um.description: Side of one sensor pixel. `null`: not known.

magnification.title: Magnification
magnification.description: Magnification from the sample to the sensor. `null`: not known.

binning.title: Binning
binning.description: Sensor pixels per frame pixel along each side. `null`: the sensor width over the frame width when the sensor width is known, else 1.

sensor_width_px.title: Sensor width
sensor_width_px.description: Width of the full sensor. `null`: not known.

Optics.description: The microscope's optics. The size of one frame pixel at the sample is `sensor_pixel_um × binning ÷ magnification`.

expected_cell_diameter_um.title: Expected cell diameter
expected_cell_diameter_um.description: The diameter of the largest cells you expect, at the sample. With the optics known it gives the diameter in pixels; it is used when `cell_diameter_px` is `null`. `null`: not given.

cell_diameter_px.title: Expected cell diameter in pixels
cell_diameter_px.description: The expected cell diameter in pixels, set directly. When set it overrides the diameter derived from `expected_cell_diameter_um` and the optics. Flattening, detection and every cell-scale radius follow the resolved diameter. `null`: derived from the physical diameter.

adapt.title: Adapt the cell diameter
adapt.description: Whether the cell diameter is estimated from the data during the run; the expected diameter is then its starting value.

psf_sigma_px.title: Point-spread σ
psf_sigma_px.description: The optics' point-spread σ: light is smoothed at this scale before a footprint's support is traced.

flatten_sigma_per_d.title: Flatten σ per diameter
flatten_sigma_per_d.description: σ of the flattening low-pass, in cell diameters.

flatten_sigma_px.title: Flatten σ
flatten_sigma_px.description: σ of the flattening low-pass in pixels; overrides the rule above. `null`: `flatten_sigma_per_d` × the cell diameter.

Scales.description: Spatial scales. Every cell-scale pixel size in the engine follows the expected cell diameter.

oneOf.description: The expected diameter is used as set.
One diameter for the field of view, estimated during the run.
A diameter per region of the field of view.

ScaleAdapt.description: How the cell diameter follows the data.

fps_override.title: Frame rate override
fps_override.description: The frame rate to use instead of the one read from the file; for a file that has none or a wrong one. `null`: the file's frame rate.

legacy_frame_fps.title: Legacy frame-count rate
legacy_frame_fps.description: The frame rate at which the durations the engine counts in fixed frames are converted. `null`: the recording's frame rate.

crop.title: Crop
crop.description: The rectangle of the motion-corrected frame that is processed. `null`: the full frame.

Input.description: Which part of the frame is processed.

CropRect.description: A rectangle of the frame, in pixels from the top-left corner.

from.title: Start from run
from.description: The past run whose footprints the run starts from. `null`: start from an empty library.

select.title: Cells taken
select.description: Which of that run's cells are taken.

ids.title: Cell ids
ids.description: The cell ids taken when `select` is `ids`.

SeedSelect.description: Which cells of a seed run are taken.

find_new_cells.title: Find new cells
find_new_cells.description: Look for new cells during Discover. Off: only the seed footprints are refined and traced.

extract.title: Extract after Discover
extract.description: Run Extract after Discover: final traces of every frame with the footprints frozen.

warmup_s.title: Calibration time
warmup_s.description: Time at the start of the recording used for the calibration (field of view, hot pixels, first noise map).

flicker.title: Flicker
flicker.description: Which flicker components are removed from each frame.

lines.title: Line artifacts
lines.description: Which line artifacts are removed from each frame.

hot_pixel_k_sigma.title: Hot-pixel threshold
hot_pixel_k_sigma.description: A pixel is hot or cold when it differs from its neighbourhood by this many noise σ.

background.title: Background floor
background.description: The background floor subtracted from each pixel.

Preprocess.description: Calibration, flicker, line and background corrections of each frame.

rel_threshold.title: Field-of-view threshold
rel_threshold.description: A pixel is inside the field of view when its mean brightness is at least this share of the bright end of the frame.

fit_disk.title: Fit a disk
fit_disk.description: Fit a disk to the field of view instead of keeping its traced shape.

margin_px.title: Edge margin
margin_px.description: Pixels removed from the field of view's edge.

boxcar_s.title: Background boxcar
boxcar_s.description: Length of the running-mean boxcar the floor is tracked on.

relax_s.title: Background relaxation
relax_s.description: Time constant of the floor's upward relaxation.

Background.description: The background floor subtracted from each pixel.

template_tau_s.title: Template time constant
template_tau_s.description: Time constant of the registration template's running average. 0 keeps the warm-up template.

template_refresh_s.title: Template refresh
template_refresh_s.description: Time between updates of the registration template.

warmup_s.title: Template warm-up
warmup_s.description: Time averaged into the first registration template.

nonrigid.title: Non-rigid
nonrigid.description: Piecewise-rigid registration on a grid of patches.

session_fix.title: Align sessions
session_fix.description: At a session boundary of a Joint run, re-register the new session and carry the preprocessing state into it.

enabled.title: Non-rigid registration
enabled.description: Refine the rigid shift per patch.

grid.title: Patch grid
grid.description: Patches per side of the grid.

max_patch_shift_px.title: Largest patch shift
max_patch_shift_px.description: The largest shift of a patch beyond the rigid shift.

NonRigid.description: Piecewise-rigid registration on a grid of patches.

enabled.title: Flat field
enabled.description: Estimate the sensor's per-pixel gain and divide it out.

gain_half_life_s.title: Gain half-life
gain_half_life_s.description: Half-life of the gain estimate's forgetting.

offset_half_life_s.title: Offset half-life
offset_half_life_s.description: Half-life of the offset estimate's forgetting.

first_map_s.title: First map after
first_map_s.description: Recording time before the first gain map.

refine_every_s.title: Refit every
refine_every_s.description: Recording time between later gain maps.

FlatField.description: The sensor flat field estimated from the recording's own motion.

accept_z.title: Add threshold
accept_z.description: A new cell must improve the held-out fit over a noise column by this many standard deviations of that null.

event_z.title: Event threshold
event_z.description: A trace value counts as an event above this many noise σ.

min_events.title: Events to add a cell
min_events.description: Held-out events a new cell needs.

event_s.title: Shortest event
event_s.description: Shortest transient that counts as an event.

probation_s.title: Probation
probation_s.description: A cell with no event in this time after its birth is deleted.

stats_half_life_s.title: Footprint statistics half-life
stats_half_life_s.description: Half-life of the running footprint statistics.

reject_cooldown_s.title: Reject cooldown
reject_cooldown_s.description: Base cooldown of a spot where a proposed cell was rejected.

event_half_life_s.title: Event-slot half-life
event_half_life_s.description: Half-life of an event slot's priority in the reservoir.

probe_gap_s.title: Probe gap
probe_gap_s.description: Shortest time between two keep-test probes of one cell.

reservoir_refine_s.title: Reservoir refine window
reservoir_refine_s.description: A cell is refined from the reservoir only within this time after its birth; later, from its running statistics alone.

cluster.title: Clusters
cluster.description: The joint footprint update of overlapping cells.

ring.title: Background ring
ring.description: The local background ring of each footprint.

margin_px.title: Tile margin
margin_px.description: Margin stored around each tile. `null`: derived from the cell diameter.
margin_px.x-derived: max(24, ceil(2.4 × cell diameter in px))

frames_per_tile.title: Frames per tile
frames_per_tile.description: Frames stored per tile for the add, merge and keep tests.

reservoir_max_mb.title: Reservoir memory
reservoir_max_mb.description: Memory cap of the frame reservoir; fewer frames per tile are kept when the full count does not fit.

budget.title: Work per frame
budget.description: Fast-loop work units per frame the slow loop paces itself against.

commit_interval_frames.title: Commit interval
commit_interval_frames.description: Fewest frames between two published library versions.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Seed of the held-out split and the reservoir's random sample.

support_alpha.title: Support error rate
support_alpha.description: Family-wise error rate of one support construction: the chance that it admits at least one pixel without light.

background.title: Background model
background.description: The background model of the published libraries.

warm_start.title: Warm starts
warm_start.description: Start each solve in a visit's comparisons at the reference model's solution.

churn.title: Churn
churn.description: Classification of adds as new, re-added or churned (display only).

corr.title: Merge correlation
corr.description: Trace correlation above which a merge of two cells is tested.

z.title: Keep-apart threshold
z.description: Two cells are kept apart when separating them beats the best single cell on held-out frames by this many standard deviations.

guard_min_sep_d.title: Merge guard separation
guard_min_sep_d.description: Pairs whose centres are at least this many cell diameters apart get the shape gate whatever their overlap. `null`: off.

guard_max_ovl.title: Merge guard overlap
guard_max_ovl.description: The neighbour guards of a merge test apply to pairs whose footprints overlap (cosine) by less than this.

refit_max_ovl.title: Refit guard overlap
refit_max_ovl.description: The same bound for the refitted-pair baseline alone.

oneOf.description: The held-out test, plus the same measured shape for a pair whose footprints do not largely coincide.

update.title: Joint update
update.description: Where overlapping cells are refitted jointly from a replay of their stored history.

sign.title: Sign rule
sign.description: Sign rule of the joint footprint step.

rho_min.title: Cluster overlap
rho_min.description: Cells join a cluster along whitened overlaps of at least this.

admit.title: Admission
admit.description: Which members of a replayed cluster are proposed.

carry.title: Carry estimate
carry.description: Carry the store's own joint estimate from one replay to the next.

l1.title: Replay L1 weight
l1.description: L1 weight of the replay's trace step, in trace-noise σ.

neighbours.title: Joint neighbour test
neighbours.description: In the add test, also check the candidate's trace against the nearby cells' traces jointly.

Cluster.description: The joint footprint update of overlapping cells.

ClusterUpdate.description: Where overlapping cells are refitted jointly.

oneOf.description: Non-negative where the member's current footprint is positive.
Non-negative on the member's whole disk.

ClusterSign.description: Sign rule of the joint footprint step.

oneOf.description: Every significant member, on the cluster's summed evidence.
Each member on its own evidence.

ClusterAdmit.description: Which members of a replayed cluster are proposed.

inner_per_d.title: Ring inner radius
inner_per_d.description: Inner radius of the ring, in cell diameters.

outer_per_d.title: Ring outer radius
outer_per_d.description: Outer radius of the ring, in cell diameters.

Ring.description: The local background ring of each footprint.

mode.title: Visit schedule
mode.description: Fixed: always the target rate. Auto: lower while visits stop finding new cells.

oneOf.description: The target while visits find new cells, lower after.

gate.title: Refine gate
gate.description: When the statistics path proposes a refinement.

z.title: Refine threshold
z.description: A refinement is accepted when its held-out gains have a paired z above this.

oneOf.description: The estimate disagrees with the footprint beyond its χ² null.
The change exceeds the estimate's own split-half noise.

RefineGate.description: When the statistics path proposes a refinement.

BackgroundModel.description: The background model of the published libraries.

readd_window_s.title: Re-add window
readd_window_s.description: Removed cells are remembered this long for the re-add test.

churn_s.title: Churn window
churn_s.description: A cell removed within this time of its add is churn.

Churn.description: Classification of adds (display only; changes no decision).

enabled.title: Look-back
enabled.description: Re-read earlier frames of the recording for each new cell.

horizon_s.title: Look-back horizon
horizon_s.description: How far before a cell's birth its frames are re-read.

rate.title: Look-back rate
rate.description: Look-back frames read per Discover frame.

Lookback.description: Re-reading past frames for the slow loop during Discover.

final.title: Final settle
final.description: The Final settle at the end of Discover.

on_factors.title: Settle on factors

cap.title: Background settle cap

level.title: Final settle

max_s.title: Final settle length
max_s.description: The most recording time the pass reads; a longer recording is sampled in blocks. `null`: three footprint-statistics half-lives.

FinalSettleLevel.description: How much of the final settle pass is read.

cluster_update.title: Joint update on factors
cluster_update.description: Where overlapping cells are refitted jointly.

guard_min_sep_d.title: Merge guard separation on factors
guard_min_sep_d.description: The merge guard separation on factors. `null`: off.

tol.title: Solve tolerance
tol.description: A solve has converged when a sweep moves no trace by more than this share of its noise σ.

enabled.title: Quality control
enabled.description: Compute the per-cell QC during the run.

min_snr.title: Minimum SNR
min_snr.description: Smallest peak SNR of a passing cell.

pair_r.title: Pair correlation
pair_r.description: Trace correlation above which two overlapping cells are a correlated pair.

motion_r2_flag.title: Follows-motion flag
motion_r2_flag.description: Share of a trace's variance explained by the frame's shift above which the cell is flagged as following motion.
